data.name: Skills
data.description: An order of the Green cavalier gains Knowledge (nature) and Survival as class skills. In addition, whenever an order of the Green cavalier attempts a Survival check to track foes of the aberrant or undead type, he receives a +%1 bonus on the check.|max(1,CavalierLVL/2)
